evals.description: Generate R code for the primary ADAS-Cog dose-response analysis, including trend test and pairwise comparisons.
evals.prompt: Please generate R code to perform the primary dose-response ADAS-Cog analysis specified in the SAP, including pairwise treatment comparisons and their 95% CIs. The submission files can be found in submissions/pilot01 folder.

assertions.description: Generates two distinct models (one for trend, one for pairwise)
Trend model uses TRTPN as a numeric/continuous predictor
Trend model emmeans uses 'at = list(TRTPN = ...)' to evaluate at specific dose levels
Pairwise model uses TRTP as a categorical predictor
Pairwise model does NOT use factor(TRTPN)
Pairwise comparisons use contrast(..., 'revpairwise', infer = TRUE)
Pairwise comparisons are extracted from the categorical model only
Site covariate uses SITEGR1 (pooled site group per SAP), NOT SITEID
Baseline covariate uses BASE directly
Filters for Efficacy Population (EFFFL == 'Y')
Filters for Analysis Record (ANL01FL == 'Y')
Filters for Week 24 (AVISIT == 'Week 24')
Filters for correct parameter (PARAMCD == 'ACTOT')
Outcome variable is CHG (Change from baseline)

evals.description: Generate R code for the co-primary CIBIC+ dose-response analysis, including trend test and pairwise comparisons.
evals.prompt: Please generate R code to perform the co-primary dose-response CIBIC+ analysis specified in the SAP, including pairwise treatment comparisons and their 95% CIs. The submission files can be found in submissions/pilot01 folder.

assertions.description: Generates two distinct models (one for trend, one for pairwise)
Trend model uses TRTPN as a numeric/continuous predictor
Trend model emmeans uses 'at = list(TRTPN = ...)' to evaluate at specific dose levels
Pairwise model uses TRTP as a categorical predictor
Pairwise model does NOT use factor(TRTPN)
Pairwise comparisons use contrast(..., 'revpairwise', infer = TRUE)
Pairwise comparisons are extracted from the categorical model only
Site covariate uses SITEGR1 (pooled site group per SAP), NOT SITEID
Model does NOT include a baseline covariate (ANOVA, not ANCOVA)
Filters for Efficacy Population (EFFFL == 'Y')
Filters for Analysis Record (ANL01FL == 'Y')
Filters for Week 24 (AVISIT == 'Week 24')
Filters for correct parameter (PARAMCD == 'CIBICVAL')
Outcome variable is AVAL (Raw value)
